overall: MARGINAL: calm on the Coron/Culion side tonight, windy on the east side, strong current at Tara and Turda
limiterDetail: The main limiter is a combination: east wind at Nangalao, Ciron, Cabunlawan, Decabaitot, Barangonan and Linapacan (11.5–14 kt now, 15–18 kt from about 2 AM to noon Wednesday), and current at Tara and Turda (0.9–1.1 kt until about 6 AM Wednesday). Rain is minor: light showers about 3–8 PM (0.1–0.7 mm/h, Coron side heaviest 3–5 PM), dry overnight, a few drops on the Coron side Wednesday late morning. Tuesday total 3.2 mm regional.

pagasa.detail: PAGASA: CLEAR. No gale, wind signal or heavy-rain warning for Calamian / MIMAROPA. The feed still lists a tropical cyclone alert for Typhoon Rosal (Champi) that doesn't name Palawan; worth a glance on the PAGASA site.

changed.title: ⚠️ What changed since this morning
items: Thursday's calm has faded, so Fri 6 supply eases from NORMAL to NEAR NORMAL. Thursday now reads 8.6 kt, gusts 14, dry (this morning: 6.3 kt, gusts 12), and Friday 9.2 kt, gusts 15. Wednesday is a touch breezier again (12 kt, gusts 18, 2.8 mm; was 11 kt, gusts 17, dry), with the east wind building to 15–18 kt from about 2 AM to noon Wednesday at Nangalao, Cabunlawan, Decabaitot, Ciron and Barangonan.

Grounds still read 6 GOOD / 8 MARGINAL / 2 POOR / 0 VERY POOR, but the mix shifted: Cabunlawan and Decabaitot improved to MARGINAL (13 kt), while Tara and Turda dropped to POOR on 0.9–1.1 kt current. Today stays NORMAL; Wed 4 and Thu 5 stay SLIGHTLY SOFT; Sun 8 stays SLIGHTLY SOFT. PAGASA shows no warning for Palawan.

shortageRisk: Surge flag OFF (unchanged). The dashboard's shortage detector stays ELEVATED for Tue–Mon (guide only; it reacts to the 0.5–0.7 kt daily currents). Tightening risk is moderate: two soft arrival days back to back (Wed 4 and Thu 5) and no strong rebound after, just near normal from Friday. Make today's landings count and lean on the Coron side, Panlaitan and Maglalambay for Wednesday–Thursday supply.
